description: This file is a shell script used in OpenWrt for system diagnostics and LED status management. It interacts with system files to control and get status indicators for system LEDs during different boot or operational states.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds the system LED associated with dmz, power, diag, or wps and sets it as the current status LED.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided argument, such as preinit, failsafe, or done.
